title: FrameAxis: Characterizing Microframe Bias and Intensity with Word Embedding
reasoning: While the paper utilizes Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as a conceptual basis for identifying semantic 'axes' (such as Care/Harm and Fairness/Cheating) within its framing analysis, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or ethics as its core objective. Rather, it treats moral foundations as categorical lenses for an unsupervised text-analysis method.
